definitions: To cause to sink in or as if in a bog.
To impede or cause to get stuck.
To become stuck in a bog or in mud.
To overwhelm or be overwhelmed with too much work or too many difficulties.
examples: The car got bogged down in the mud.
He was bogged down with paperwork.
The project was bogged down by bureaucracy.
Don't let yourself get bogged down in details.
